source: Bay County Supervisor of Elections campaign finance system (VoterFocus), https://www.voterfocus.com/ws/WScand/candidate_pr.php?c=Bay, embedded at https://www.bayvotesfl.gov/candidates/candidate-committee-finances/. Reporting groups (el=): 14, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 25, 27, 28, 30, 26, 31, 32. Per-candidate itemized CSV export: https://www.voterfocus.com/CampaignFinance/export.php?op=CFINANCE&cand_id={id}&dhc=0&county=bay
method: Same build as ../elections/finance_2026.json (data/elections/scripts/build.py): SOE summary totals per campaign, itemized exports with amendments applied and reconciled to the summary, contributors classified by the filed code and corrected only where plainly wrong. Individuals are counted and summed, never named. Expenditures are totals only.
gaps: Left out (party posts and a federal race that file with the SOE): Rep State Committeeman (2016) x2; Rep State Committeeman (2020) x2; Rep State Committeeman (2024) x2; Rep State Committeewoman (2016) x2; Rep State Committeewoman (2020) x3; Rep State Committeewoman (2024) x3; United States Senate (2016).
Campaigns whose itemized lines do not add up to the SOE summary are flagged in reconciliation; the SOE summary figures are used for totals.
Political committees (for example referendum committees) are not candidates and are not included.
